_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in your own endpoints. config.json holds credentials — it is gitignored, never commit it.

mes._comment: U9 Smart Factory (MEAN stack: Node + Express + MongoDB + AngularJS). Read-only client in lib/u9_client.mjs. The AES key/IV used for signin are constants baked into the vendor's frontend bundle — see README, section 'Adapting to another U9 deployment'.

mysql._comment: Template for a PLM / OA database (Oracle / SQL Server need a different driver and provider, see README)
mysql.label: PLM database

dcs_http._comment: Services that already exist and expose HTTP — forwarding to them means the MCP server never holds the warehouse password.
